title: The parent's read of a review delegation result omits its resultId, so another root can never read that original review by exact identity
outcome: The parent's read of a review delegation result omits its resultId, so another root can never read that original review by exact identity
acceptance: termal_get_session_result (and the parent's delegation result read) returns the immutable resultId together with the submissionAttempt for a completed review delegation
A root other than the parent that is given that exact submissionAttempt and resultId can read the original structured review result

A regression test covers: the parent read exposes resultId, and a non-parent root reads the same result by exact submissionAttempt plus resultId while a read without resultId stays refused with exact_identity_required
